subject: WS D interfaces live: DecisionRecord, taste modes, multi-item, agentic
body: Commit 365d9b9. (1) research/decisions.py: DecisionRecord exactly as PLAN 12.6 (run_id, iter, point D1-D6, context, options, chosen, user_model_choice, user_model_confidence, evidence, overrode_taste, arm, code_version); validate_record()/load_decisions(). Each research run writes runs/<run_id>/decisions.jsonl (--decisions-dir) and <report>_decisions.jsonl next to the report, plus DECISION facts in shared memory. (2) ResearchConfig.use_taste is now a read-only property; the field is taste_mode none|model|prompt (CLI --taste-mode, --no-taste = alias for none, default model iff --researcher/--taste-track given). (3) Findings now have ids (f1, f2, ...) plus n, interpretation (D5), per_item_delta in multi-item mode; status can also be 'drifted'. (4) research --items-per-iter N with --benchmark-items scores interventions over N dev items per iteration, paired by item. (5) research/advisor.TasteAdvisor consumes WS A's UserModel via taste.usermodel.load_model(usermodel.json, llm); without usermodel.json it wraps profile.json (D1 only).
